Convolution + SSD[B,T,8192]
in_proj[B,T,18560]Split into z=8192, x=8192, B=1024, C=1024, dt=128
↓
Causal depthwise convolution + SiLU on x/B/C[B,T,10240]kernel=4; independent convolution per channel
↓
SSD scan[B,T,128,64]A=-exp(A_log), Δ=softplus(dt+dt_bias), D is the skip vector

Gating + RMSNorm[B,T,8192]Grouped RMSNorm after y × SiLU(z)
↓
out_proj[B,T,4096]
  • Per-layer SSM runtime state [B,128,64,128]; convolution cache [B,10240,4]. Neither is a trainable parameter.
  • B and C are input-dependent activations, each [B,T,8,128]; they are not additional static parameter matrices.
  • in_proj/out_proj have no bias; conv1d has bias.
